interpretation.ownerIdentity: Ownership is fail-closed in ExactClaimBinderV2_1, not expressible as a provider-facing schema restriction: sourceAlias remains generic string/minLength.
interpretation.wholeAtom: The current policy and instructions require whole atoms to be sourceAlias-only and remove selectionMode. This is a meaningful prevention of retyping, but verbatimText remains syntactically available for legitimate strict substrings.
interpretation.sparse: The response is an unconstrained claims array; an empty list is codec-valid and no every-owned-subject decision ledger exists.
interpretation.halo: A context-only alias passes the current schema/codec as a proposed subject and is refused only at binding. Halo leakage therefore remains a guardrail event, not a structurally impossible wire state.

designImplication: P5C may move occurrence identity and ownership entirely to the harness and give the model an owned subject index/decision interface; this audit does not change production behavior.
